description: Meteor addon for constantiam.net's tab list: join year or play time from /joindate, players who left, offline friends, join year statistics, auto-fit (formerly Join Years)

mods.name: Constantiam Tab
mods.description: Tab list for constantiam.net: join dates and play time from /joindate, players who left, friends, join year statistics and a list that fits the screen.

releases.notes:
Join Years is now **Constantiam Tab**.

For Minecraft 1.21.11 with Fabric and Meteor Client. Put `constantiam-tab-2.0.0.jar` in your `mods` folder (remove `join-years-1.0.0.jar` if you have it) and switch on **Constantiam Tab** in Meteor's "Claude's Meteor Addons" category. Your saved join years carry over from `join-years.json`.

### New
- Join year **or** play time next to each name, sorted by full join date (oldest first) or play time (most first); each order can be flipped
- Players who left stay at the end of the list, dimmed, with how long ago they were last seen. Offline players are never looked up
- Offline Meteor friends are listed and looked up once per session; friends who have never been on the server show "never joined"
- Join year statistics panel to the right of the list, of players online now or of everyone logged
- Auto-fit keeps the list on screen and above the hotbar: more columns, then taller columns, then smaller text
- Works with Meteor's Better Tab, which the module keeps on

mods.name: Join Years
mods.description: Shows the year each player first joined constantiam.net in the tab list, using /joindate.

releases.notes:
First release of Join Years, a Meteor Client addon for **constantiam.net**.

It shows the year each player first joined in front of their name in the tab list, colour-coded from 2016 (gold) to 2026 (grey). Older years use warmer colours, so veterans stand out.

## Requirements
- Minecraft **1.21.11** with Fabric
- Meteor Client for 1.21.11

## Install
Put `join-years-1.0.0.jar` in your `mods` folder, then turn on **Join Years** in Meteor's GUI.

## How it works
- Looks up the players in the tab list with `/joindate`, one at a time, and hides the replies from chat.
- Saves every result to `meteor-client/join-years.json` (name, first seen date, play time), so each player is only looked up once.
- Follows the command's cooldown (just under 6 seconds) and slows down by itself if the server refuses a lookup.
- Only runs on constantiam.net unless you turn off `only-constantiam`.

`.join-years` in chat shows the year colours and how many players are saved.
